RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  April 23, 2010/Vaisakha 3, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small
and Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
705
Mango orchards in Malihabad
3065. SHRI AHMAD SAEED
MALIHABADI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has supplied
genuine pesticide at reasonable rate through
Government outlets at Malihabad,
Lucknow;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken to protect the
patented Dasehri mango; and
(d) whether Government has taken
necessary measures to supply regular and
sufficient supply of electricity and water
for irrigation of mango orchards in
Malihabad?
Heavy erosion of land in coastal areas
of Kerala
3066. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether monsoon invasion of high
waves by high intrusion of sea water results
heavy erosion of land in coastal areas of
Kerala that have high density of
population;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
loss due to coastal erosion for last five
years, category-wise and year-wise;
(c) if so, whether calamity due to coastal
erosion is considered as a natural calamity;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Production of pulses
3067. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether in 1998-99, the country's
pulse production peaked at 14.91 million
tonnes and ever since the pulse production
had never caught up with the population
growth at an average of 1.3 per cent to 1.5
per cent per annum;
(b) whether despite rise in prices on
average annual basis during this period by
6.3 per cent for Chana, 6.1 per cent for
Arhar, 6.5 per cent for Moong and 8.6 per

706
cent for Urad, no corresponding crop
migration from cereals to pulses had taken
place;
(c) whether it would be futile to attempt
bringing more acreage under pulses; and
(d) if so, whether Government would
focus on improving productivity?
Maritime Zones of India Act, 1976
3068. SHRI T.K. RANGARAJAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Maritime Zones of India
Act, 1976 stipulates the distance of 12
nautical miles from the coast under the
compete authority of State concerned;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
amend the clause;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Plan to increase production of pulses
and oilseeds
†3069. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has formulated a new plan to increase the
production of pulses and oilseeds in
the country during the financial year
2010-2011;
(b) if so, the outlines of this plan and
State-wise number of villages of the country
selected for implementation of this plan
and the basis on which those villages have
been selected; and
(c) the targeted production and the
amount allocated for expenditure under this
plan?
Production of pulses and oilseeds
†3070. SHRI RA VI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the past
years several schemes had been
implemented by Government to increase
the production of pulses and oilseeds in
the country;
(b) if so, the schemes implemented in
the country to increase the production of
above mentioned crops during the year
2007-2008 to 2009-2010; and
(c) the amount spent each year during
the said period on implementation of each
scheme and the extent of which the
production of above mentioned crops
increased during each year of the said
period?
Problems of rainfed farming
†3071. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 152 given in the Rajya Sabha on
3rd July, 2009 and state:
(a) the problems of rainfed farming
identified by Government;
(b) the programmes being run by his
Ministry to solve each problem;

watersheds identified in the entire country
under the Integrated Watershed

Rajasthan separately; and
(d) the area of rainfed land where
production of crops has been ensured
thereupon?
